description: This file contains repository functions for database operations related to manufacturing maintenance, including CRUD operations for equipment, parameters, readings, alerts, work orders, and parts using SQLAlchemy ORM.

methods.name: datetime _utcnow_naive()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC datetime as a naive datetime object, compatible with MySQL DATETIME.

methods.name: Optional[Equipment] get_equipment_by_asset_tag(db: Session, asset_tag: str)
methods.description: Fetches an Equipment record by its asset tag.

methods.name: list[Equipment] list_equipment(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all Equipment records ordered by descending ID.

methods.name: ParameterCatalog ensure_parameter_catalog(db: Session, name: str, unit: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Ensures a ParameterCatalog exists with the given name and optional unit, creating or updating it as necessary.

methods.name: Optional[EquipmentParameter] get_equipment_parameter( db: Session, equipment_id: int, parameter_id: int, component_id: Optional[int] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves an EquipmentParameter based on equipment ID, parameter ID, and optional component ID.

methods.name: list[EquipmentReading] list_readings(db: Session, equipment_asset_tag: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Lists EquipmentReadings, optionally filtered by equipment asset tag and limited in count.

methods.name: list[Alert] list_alerts( db: Session, equipment_asset_tag: Optional[str] = None, status: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 200 )
methods.description: Lists Alert records, optionally filtered by equipment asset tag and alert status, limited in number.

methods.name: list[WorkOrder] list_work_orders(db: Session, status: Optional[str] = None, limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Lists WorkOrder records, optionally filtered by status, limited in number.

methods.name: Optional[WorkOrder] get_work_order_by_number(db: Session, wo_number: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkOrder by its work order number.

methods.name: Optional[WorkOrder] get_work_order(db: Session, wo_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkOrder by its ID.

methods.name: list[Part] list_parts(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of Part records ordered by name.

methods.name: list[WorkOrderPart] reserve_parts_for_work_order( db: Session, work_order: WorkOrder, items: list[tuple[Part, int]] )
methods.description: Reserves parts for a work order based on requested quantities, updating stock and reservation details.

methods.name: list[Severity] count_open_alerts_by_equipment(db: Session, equipment_id: int)
methods.description: Counts and returns a list of severities for open alerts associated with a specific equipment ID.

methods.name: EquipmentReading create_reading( db: Session, *, equipment: Equipment, parameter: ParameterCatalog, value: float, unit: Optional[str], recorded_by: Optional[str], source: SourceType, note: Optional[str], recorded_at: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Creates and saves a new equipment reading record.
